items: Lip-sync fixed. Measured cut 2 on the assembled film: all three "I'm out"s were 0.25 to 0.33 s early, and the nurse was off phrase by phrase. The voices stay where they were; each talking clip now starts where its mouth opens just before its voice (the three investors and the minister's pitch).

The nurse re-voiced in her locked voice, words unchanged, without pause tags: her clip barely pauses, so a plain read matches her mouth phrase for phrase ("One ward" on her pursed lips, then "Six months", the middle line, and "you stop paying me" landing on the p and m).

End card: the National Audit Office finding, as first pitched: only 8% of £432 billion of the government's biggest projects had a robust plan to find out if they worked (Evaluating government spending, HC 860, Dec 2021, read at source).
Music: four pitch-show-style beds are being made on Suno; links to follow.
The minister's head turns away mid-pitch for a moment (in cut 2 too): keep, or cut to the panel there?
Trim toward ~20 s: which beats or lines go?
